name: Filter Bar
summary: Compact horizontal in-place filter composition with explicit single or multiple selection, canonical choice controls, one controlled selected-value collection, and immediate target-owned query commitment.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native fieldset and compact horizontal filter boundary; it is never a navigation landmark.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible localized group label; single mode uses the equivalent canonical Segmented Control legend.

anatomy.name: options
anatomy.description: Ordered wrapping option bar; single mode uses the equivalent canonical Segmented Control options surface.

anatomy.name: choice
anatomy.description: Multiple-mode presentation hook composed on a canonical Checkbox; single mode composes canonical Segmented Control items.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Multiple-mode canonical native checkbox; single mode uses canonical same-name radio inputs.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Complete visible multiple-mode choice label; single mode uses canonical segment labels.

variants.name: single
variants.description: At most one selected value through canonical radio-backed Segmented Control composition.

variants.name: multiple
variants.description: Zero or more selected values through independent canonical Checkboxes.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One compact intrinsic size that wraps from available container space.

states.name: default
states.description: Available filter group with a valid option collection and possibly no selection.

states.name: selected
states.description: Controlled selected values projected to the corresponding native checked controls.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover inherited from the canonical choice control and contextual wrapper.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Visible native Checkbox or radio focus without a second focus owner.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Complete fieldset or individual target-authored option is unavailable.

behavior.name: canonicalChoiceComposition
behavior.description: Single mode composes canonical Segmented Control radios; Multiple mode composes canonical Checkboxes. There are no destination links, aria-current state, hidden duplicate inputs or custom selection roles.

behavior.name: controlledSelection
behavior.description: One ordered selectedValues projection is authoritative. Single mode normalizes it to at most one valid value; Multiple mode preserves valid values in option order. Empty is valid in both modes.

behavior.name: immediateCommitRequest
behavior.description: Every accepted native choice change immediately requests the complete next selected-value collection. The component has no Apply, Cancel or draft selection.

behavior.name: targetQueryLifecycle
behavior.description: Capable Web and Shopify targets choose the query key, serialization and push-versus-replace policy; synchronize URL, Back/Forward and results; and own cancellation, pending, error, empty, announcements, focus, analytics and pagination reset.

behavior.name: failClosed
behavior.description: Blank label or name, fewer than two valid unique options, or otherwise invalid authored content omits the complete component instead of emitting an unnamed or ineffective group.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Exclusive single or multiple selection model; it changes the canonical child control semantics, not only appearance.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Non-empty localized visible label naming the complete filter choice group.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Target-selected native field name repeated across every choice; Web targets may also use it as their chosen query key.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Ordered target-owned option records with stable unique value, complete localized label and optional availability; at least two valid records are required.

properties.name: selectedValues
properties.description: One controlled ordered collection of selected stable option values. It may be empty; Single mode accepts at most one valid value.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the complete native fieldset and every contained choice unavailable.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id references for persistent target-authored guidance about the filter and associated results.

accessibility: Use one native fieldset with a visible legend. Do not render nav, links, aria-current, menu, tablist or toolbar semantics for filtering.
Single mode composes same-name native radios through Segmented Control; Multiple mode composes independent named native Checkboxes.
Preserve native Tab, Arrow and Space behavior supplied by the canonical controls and keep every visible label complete.
Selected state remains checked state and is not conveyed only by color; focus, selection and boundaries remain visible in forced colors.
The target that updates results owns a concise result announcement, pending/error/empty distinction, focus policy and Back/Forward synchronization; Filter Bar does not create a competing live region.
Omit the complete component when its label, native name or minimum valid option collection is unavailable.

web.notes: Canonical radio/Checkbox markup, controlled checked projection, native change requests and compact intrinsic CSS are implemented. The consuming Web target chooses query serialization, History API policy and results lifecycle.

shopify.notes: Compose canonical controls from target filter records and synchronize the chosen query parameter plus section results; no neutral query key or Shopify filter schema is frozen.

react.notes: Accept options and selectedValues arrays and emit the complete next array without a mirrored uncontrolled store.

swiftui.notes: Map Single to native exclusive selection and Multiple to independent toggles while preserving one selected-value collection.

compose.notes: Map Single to exclusive selection and Multiple to checkboxes; host navigation owns query state.
